title: Quiz Master
story: 20 questions. 4 categories. A ticking timer. A final score and grade. Welcome to Quiz Master — the trivia engine that could power a pub quiz, an exam prep tool, or a family game night. Multiple choice, timed rounds, and a results summary that feels like a report card.
why: Quiz Master combines structs for questions, enums for categories, Vec for question bank, Map for stats, and timer logic — a complete interactive testing system.
analogy: A standardized test bubble sheet with a timer ticking down. Each question has four options, one correct bubble to fill. At the end, the Scantron machine grades you: 18/20 correct = 90% = A. Your Quiz Master IS the Scantron machine — ask, answer, score, grade.
try_it: Add a countdown timer per question (15 seconds). Add random question shuffling. Implement difficulty progression: easy questions first, harder later. Add a 'review wrong answers' screen at the end showing correct answers for missed questions.
tips: Store the correct answer as an INDEX into options, not the text itself
Filter questions by category before starting — smaller, focused quiz
Calculate grade as percentage: correct / total * 100, map to letter
common_mistakes: Comparing user answer string with option text — use indices for fast, safe comparison
Not handling empty question bank — division by zero in grade calculation
Shuffling options but not updating correct_index — answer is now at the wrong position
